meta.name: mode-creator
meta.description: Interactively create, install, activate, and verify custom claude-mem modes, including domain-specific observation types, concept tags, optional Telegram alerts, bot setup, worker restart, and startup-context verification. Use this whenever someone asks to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, track domain-specific notes, add observation types or tags, or send Telegram notifications for particular memories—even if they do not use the word "mode."

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自定义 AI 该记住哪些内容,按领域打标签并推送提醒
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让 AI 按自己的领域习惯记住要点并在关键记忆上收到提醒
copy.tagline_en: Customize what your assistant remembers, tag notes by domain, and fire alerts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your assistant to remember domain notes and alert you on key ones.

howto.what: Claude 会先问你在做什么工作,据此提出一套观察类型和概念标签,经你确认后装成 claude-mem 自定义模式,按需配置 Telegram 提醒、重启 worker,并验证它在启动上下文里生效。
howto.when: 当你要求自定义 claude-mem 记住的内容、新建或修改模式、添加观察类型或标签等,甚至没说出「mode」时,也会触发。

say.text: 我是做建筑设计的,想记录每个设计决策和客户偏好
say.note: 它会先访谈,再给模式草案待你确认

say.text: 在代码模式基础上加实验结论和数据契约变更
say.note: 会复用 code 作为实现基础再替换分类

say.text: 给「生产事故」这类观察开 Telegram 提醒
say.note: 会引导配置机器人并发一条测试消息

howto.what_en: Claude interviews you about your work, proposes observation types and concept tags, installs the approved mode in local claude-mem, optionally configures Telegram alerts, restarts the worker, and verifies it in startup context.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to change what claude-mem remembers, create or edit a mode, add observation types or tags, or send Telegram alerts for specific memories — even without saying "mode".

say_en.text: I do architecture; capture each design decision and client preference.
say_en.note: It interviews first, then drafts a mode for you to approve.

say_en.text: Add experiment outcomes and data-contract changes to code mode.
say_en.note: Reuses code as a base, then swaps the taxonomy.

say_en.text: Send Telegram alerts for production-incident observations.
say_en.note: Guides bot setup and sends one test message.
